GenAiPlugin.description: Handles requests to assess the regulatory compliance of MLR submission documents.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Handle requests to pre-screen an MLR submission for regulatory compliance, including FDA 21 CFR Part 202 advertising requirements, fair balance obligations, brief summary requirements, and off-label promotion rules enforced by the FDA Office of Prescription Drug Promotion. Use this topic when the user asks about regulatory review, FDA compliance, off-label promotion, or wants to run a regulatory pre-screen on a submission. Do not handle medical accuracy or legal compliance questions — those are separate topics.
